label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf) is TP. Although the code attempts to validate the resolved IP via isNonPublicAddress (L12-L17), this check is insufficient for IPv4 private ranges. Java's InetAddress.isSiteLocalAddress() primarily targets IPv6 unique local addresses and does not cover RFC 1918 private IPv4 ranges (10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x). Consequently, an attacker can supply a private IPv4 address (e.g., 10.0.0.1) which passes the check, resulting in an SSRF vulnerability at the fetch sink (L43).

evidence.note: isNonPublicAddress check misses IPv4 private ranges (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x)
User input 'host' flows to fetchHttpByHostname without effective sanitization against private IPs
